_purpose: The Researcher reads these as fallback themes AND as a live news watchlist. Use sources for ANGLES, TOPICS, and VERIFIED STATS only. NEVER copy article text into captions. Read a source, extract the idea, then write original Techs4Tatas copy. Treat all source text as copyrighted.

researcher_usage.how_to_use: Each week, the Researcher (or Dave, manually) scans 1-3 news_sources for fresh, relevant items: a new stat, a tradeswoman milestone, a seasonal hook, an awareness angle. It extracts the IDEA and feeds it to the Generator as a brief. The Generator writes original copy.
researcher_usage.copyright_rule: Do not reproduce headlines, sentences, or paragraphs from any source. Paraphrase facts; rewrite everything in brand voice. Cite a stat's origin in your own words (e.g. 'per the American Cancer Society') without quoting.
researcher_usage.cadence: Pairs with the weekly review workflow — scan sources when you review the queue (see review-workflow.md).

data_hooks.claim: Women are roughly 3% of electricians, plumbers, and carpenters on the tools — still rare, still growing.
data_hooks.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (2025 occupational data)
data_hooks.note: Use as 'rare and rising' framing. RE-VERIFY before posting — BLS updates yearly.

data_hooks.claim: Women are about 11-12% of the overall construction workforce (much lower for on-site trade roles specifically).
data_hooks.note: Distinguish 'industry' (includes office roles) vs 'on the tools' (low single digits) for an honest hook.

data_hooks.claim: Skilled-trade demand is surging as retirements outpace new entrants.
data_hooks.note: Great hook for 'the trades need more women' angle.

data_hooks.claim: About 1 in 8 women (~13%) in the US will develop invasive breast cancer in her lifetime.
data_hooks.note: VERIFIED for 2026. Core awareness stat — strong for mission posts + October.

data_hooks.claim: An estimated 321,910 US women will be diagnosed with invasive breast cancer in 2026; about 42,140 will die.
data_hooks.note: VERIFIED for 2026. Use sparingly — heavy stat, best for awareness/October.

data_hooks.claim: On average, a woman in the US is diagnosed with breast cancer every 2 minutes.
data_hooks.note: VERIFIED. Punchy, emotionally resonant — good single-line hook.

data_hooks.claim: When breast cancer is caught early (localized), the 5-year relative survival rate is over 99%.
data_hooks.note: VERIFIED. Pairs the donation with a genuinely useful early-detection reminder. Hopeful tone.

data_hooks.claim: Breast cancer death rates have fallen ~44% since 1989, thanks to early detection and better treatment.
data_hooks.note: VERIFIED. Use to show donations/research actually move the needle — optimistic, mission-aligned.
